notes: s(m,3) = 13m for all m >= 1 (NT_E13_1.s_m_3 in E13_1.lean). s(2,4) = 82 and s(4,4) = 160 (s_2_4, s_4_4 in NT/E13.1/E13_1_lrat.lean, s defined as the least s with no valid 4-colouring of [m, m+s]): upper bounds by kernel-checked LRAT for the symmetry-broken CNF defined in Lean with an encoding lemma proving the symmetry breaking sound (CaDiCaL 2.1.3, trimmed; m=2: 4.58M hints, 98 min kernel; m=4: split on one variable, 5.73M hints, 123 min kernel; LRAT data 89 MB not in git, see NT/E13.1/lrat/README.md), lower bounds by an explicit colouring of [2,83] and the Abbott-Znam colouring giving s(m,4) >= 40m for all m (lower_m_4). General n open. Outside Lean: s(1,4) = 44 (Schur S(4), Baumert) and s(3,4) = 120 (SAT, no proof kept).
